items.new_text: Never represent money with floating point; store currency in a separate column.
Use `text` plus `check` for enumerations, never a native Postgres `enum`: adding a native enum value can block production migration, and these lists will grow.
Keep the data-model section 1 conventions in one place. A change here prevents a second table from acquiring different timestamps from the first.

The priority scale belongs in `@pipe/core/conversa`, not here.

This module imports `drizzle-orm/pg-core` to build constraints, so its consumers pull in the driver. A browser component sorts the agent queue; a separate weight map there had diverged. Pure rules belong in the pure-rule package and are imported into the schema for constraints, never the reverse.
Closed catalog for `evento_atendimento.tipo` from data-model section 4.

The channel that supplied received media, set only by the webhook (`dominio/entrada.ts`), never by manual upload (`controladores/anexos.ts`). Download code (`dominio/midia.ts`) uses it to obtain the Graph token. See `0033_download_de_midia.sql`.
`bytes = 0` plus a reference `chave_storage` (`meta:` or URL) means not yet downloaded.
Keep CPF/CNPJ in `text`: CNPJ becomes alphanumeric starting in 2026.
Conversations contain personal data, so deletion on the subject's request was supported from the start.

The `id` of the matching Twenty `person`. It lets a Desk deep link open the customer RECORD rather than CRM home.

It is null until mirroring completes; while null, Desk shows no link. See `docs/specs/2026-09-07-integracao-twenty.md` section 4.
Start with NO priority. A prioritization rule or a person sets it; the old default (`media`) sorted the queue by a value nobody chose. See `NIVEIS_PRIORIDADE`.
Module 3 covers conversations. The initial channels were WhatsApp Cloud API, email, and site widget; `TIPOS_CANAL` now also includes Instagram and Messenger.

items.new_text: Supports automatic-close protection: do not close when the agent owes a reply.
WhatsApp's 24-hour customer-service window is recomputed for each inbound contact message. Null means a channel without a window, such as email or widget.
No foreign key: `mensagem` is partitioned and unique by (id, criada_em).

Migration 0040: the flow message log (`carregarLogDeMensagens`) finds conversations for the bot's channel by `inbox_id` before descending to `mensagem`. Without this index, that lookup would scan all of `conversa`.
Partitioned monthly on `criada_em`. A partitioned table's primary key must include the partition key, hence `(id, criada_em)` instead of `id` alone.
When set, this lets the effort report discount text that the agent did not type.
Link a customer reply to the campaign send that triggered it so the report counts the window from sending, not from a calendar day.

Meta token and SMTP password are encrypted at rest by `packages/db/src/segredo.ts`, with the key outside the database (section 6). Only fields in `CAMPOS_SECRETOS_DE_CANAL` are encrypted; the rest remain readable for diagnostics.

Channel- or type-specific data without a dedicated column.

Persist positional template values through sending. Otherwise they exist only in a queue job, and a lost job loses both retry and audit evidence.

For Instagram, store the conversation origin: direct message, story reply with story reference, mention, or comment promoted to a private conversation with a link to the post.
Every outbound message passes through this outbox with its own state and backoff retry. `mensagem_id` has no foreign key because `mensagem` is partitioned.

Two webhook routing keys live in COLUMNS rather than `config`: Meta template and account events cannot use a per-tenant URL, so they all reach one route. The payload identifies the tenant (`entry[].id` is the WABA; `metadata.phone_number_id` is the number). Payload resolution is a query; querying unindexed jsonb would scan it. See `docs/specs/2026-09-07-webhook-por-cliente.md`.

Pin and mark unread PER AGENT, not per conversation (migration 0041).

This mirrors PIN/UNPIN and UNREAD/READ from the source card menu (`TicketMenuOptions`). Null `fixada_em` means unpinned; null `nao_lida_em` means read. A row exists only while at least one flag is set (CHECK), and the domain removes it when neither remains. The domain enforces a limit of 50 pinned conversations.

`numero_id` is deliberately globally unique, not tenant-scoped: two tenants cannot own the same number. The index is partial because only WhatsApp has this identifier. `waba_id` currently has a partial nonunique index for lookup.
